react_result.final_narrative_text: The differential metabolome converges on a single biological module across three independent analytical paradigms. RaMP multi-DB ORA identified Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as the top pathway (FDR 6.97e-14, fold enrichment 1430×) with five lipid mediators as hits: arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219), 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2 (KEGG:C14717), 5(S)-HETE (KEGG:C04805), leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909), and 15(S)-HETE (KEGG:C04742). Mummichog's empirical-compound m/z network independently ranked Arachidonic acid metabolism first (p=7.56e-4, 11/11 input compounds matched) and Leukotriene metabolism third (p=0.025), confirming the same upstream pool. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA reproduced this with KEGG:hsa00590 as the sole significant hit, covering the same four HETEs and leukotriene A4. Arachidonic acid is the shared substrate driving all three branch pathways — the lipoxygenase arm produces 5-HETE and leukotriene A4, the cyclooxygenase arm yields 15-deoxy-PGJ2, and the cytochrome-P450 ω-hydroxylase arm generates 15-HETE. Phenytoin and 3-methyladenine did not map to the eicosanoid cluster in any tool and likely represent pharmacological or autophagy-related off-target signals. The cross-paradigm consensus (ORA + m/z-network + KEGG PSEA all rank 1) with five verified member metabolites across three database namespaces establishes arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant perturbed pathway.

react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven differentially abundant metabolites fall into two distinct clusters. Five are lipid mediators that converge on the eicosanoid synthesis pathway across three independent analytical paradigms. RaMP ORA on the merged SMPDB/KEGG/WikiPathways library ranked Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) first with FDR 6.97e-14, fold enrichment 1430, and five input metabolites as hits. Mummichog's empirical-compound m/z network independently ranked Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) first with p=9.24e-4, and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA identified hsa00590 as its top hit with four lipid mediators as hits. All four HETEs/leukotriene A4 are shared between ORA and mummichog hits, and all five lipids are confirmed pathway members of WP:WP167 via RaMP. Arachidonic acid is the upstream substrate; the COX branch yields 15-deoxy-delta-12,14-prostaglandin J2, the LOX branch produces leukotriene A4 and both HETEs, and cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylase generates 15-HETE. Phenytoin and 3-methyladenine did not map to any eicosanoid pathway in any tool and are absent from the RaMP hit lists, suggesting they represent pharmacological or autophagy-related off-target signals.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven differentially abundant metabolites fall into two distinct clusters. Five are lipid mediators that converge on the eicosanoid synthesis pathway across three independent analytical paradigms. RaMP ORA on the merged SMPDB/KEGG/WikiPathways library ranked Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) first with FDR 6.97e-14, fold enrichment 1430, and five input metabolites as hits. Mummichog's empirical-compound m/z network independently ranked Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) first with p=9.24e-4, and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA identified hsa00590 as its top hit with four lipid mediators as hits. All four HETEs/leukotriene A4 are shared between ORA and mummichog hits, and all five lipids are confirmed pathway members of WP:WP167 via RaMP. Arachidonic acid is the upstream substrate; the COX branch yields 15-deoxy-delta-12,14-prostaglandin J2, the LOX branch produces leukotriene A4 and both HETEs, and cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylase generates 15-HETE. Phenytoin and 3-methyladenine did not map to any eicosanoid pathway in any tool and are absent from the RaMP hit lists, suggesting they represent pharmacological or autophagy-related off-target signals.
